text:
anya: quick Q — seeing long tail queueing in priority windows for the embeds endpoint. should the console nudge tenants to reduce batch sizes before hitting soft quotas?

mike: can you paste the queue histo? my hunch is small multi-tenant bursts are filling the priority window.

anya: quick snapshot from last 5m -> high-priority 95p q_len = 18, normal 95p q_len = 45. time_in_queue 95p: high=220ms, normal=480ms. trace sample: /traces/abc123

sam: +1 to a proportional fairshare approach. also we need a dynamic cap per-tenant based on recent success rate and tail latency. console can show a suggested batch_size and an explainers CTA.

mike: proposal sketch: priority buckets get a base_queue, elastic ceiling if throughput justifies it, otherwise shrink. console CTA: "reduce batch size" + estimated savings.

drew: evaluation plan: canary 10% traffic, collect q_len, q_wait_ms, drop_rate, reroute_count, p95 latency per-tenant. compare cost/unit.

anya: UX asks: add per-route tooltip that says "priority queue auto-scales — click for details" and a link to trace why a request was routed to normal tier.

console-ux-bot: mockup uploaded -> https://figma.com/s/priority-queue-nudge (preview).

sam: note edge case: mixed-dims batching. when we split a batch into fragments we create multiple queue entries. we need to account for fragment count when sizing windows and when surfacing preflight hints.

mike: config snippet idea:
```
priority_window:
  base_queue: 20
  elastic_limit: 50
  scale_policy: throughput_based
  cooldown_s: 60
```

drew: can we also expose "estimated units per request" in the console and in an SDK response header? helps users understand cost impact of their batch shape.

anya: :thumbsup: let's run the canary. who owns rollout? @mike?

mike: i can own the canary + dashboards. plan: 10% traffic for 48h, compare p95 latency and cost/unit delta. abort if regression > 5% or error rate increases.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for embed-queue-autoscale v1 -> traffic 10% (partitioned by tenant hash).

sam: add alert rule: auto-shrink triggered > 3 times in 1h -> page oncall + create incident for priority-queue.

anya: sweet. mike/sam/drew will sync in #embed-ops tomorrow 10am. i'll add figma + console copy in the PR.
